timing_boundaries.continuous_api_wall_seconds: FNIT API call and final target-device synchronization after imports/CUDA initialization; includes automatic volume ICA/AROMA and pipeline publication/cleanup; excludes subsequent wrapper validation
timing_boundaries.driver_through_saved_output_validation_s: FNIT API-start boundary through saved-image validation, private output binding and raw/config/metadata rechecks; excludes imports/CUDA initialization, monitor join, final source checks and final report save

candidate.timing_boundary: FNIT API and driver-through-validation intervals reported separately; both start after imports/CUDA initialization. Automatic mature volume includes ICA/AROMA clean work. The API excludes subsequent wrapper validation; the driver validation interval still excludes monitor/source finalization and final report save

timing_boundaries.container_process_wall_seconds: Official container process creation through exit; wrapper validation and saved QC excluded
timing_boundaries.wall_seconds: Original container-start through wrapper filename-binding/QC failure and saved original report; later complete output recovery and elapsed recovery span excluded
timing_boundaries.continuous_wall_through_saved_QC_seconds: Original container-start through wrapper filename-binding/QC failure and saved original report; later complete output recovery and elapsed recovery span excluded
timing_boundaries.recovered_QC_seconds: Independent later saved-output verification and binding recovery; original MRI workflow clocks unchanged; waiting gap excluded
timing_boundaries.recovery_gap_since_original_end_seconds: Wall span from original wrapper end to later recovery completion; includes recovered_QC_seconds and any intervening wait, not MRI compute time; never add it to recovered_QC_seconds

reference.timing_boundary: Official MRI process completed; original wrapper filename/QC binding failed, and later corrective QC is a separate interval with waiting gap excluded

reference_qc_recovery.timing_scope: later full saved-output checks; original workflow clocks immutable

method.protocol_difference: FNIT recon-all fixed FreeSurfer 8.2 algorithms plus FNIRT versus complete fMRIPrep 25.2.4 with FreeSurfer 7.3.2 and ANTs; scientific protocols/algorithm versions differ
method.timed_work_difference: FNIT automatic mature volume computes/saves both preproc and ICA/AROMA clean outputs and all four volumes are checked by its runner; official complete fMRIPrep does not denoise BOLD, and its default anatomical workflow also registers internal MNI152NLin2009cAsym in addition to the requested MNI152NLin6Asym outputs. Accuracy compares only preproc and corresponding CIFTI. Raw whole durations and corresponding steps remain separate; no general speedup inferred
method.strict_numerical_equivalence: not_assessed; metrics describe complete protocol differences
method.pearson: each complete 180-frame nonconstant pair; undefined constant pairs counted, never assigned r=0 or removed from error metrics
method.rmse: sqrt(mean((candidate-reference)^2)) over every point/frame in each named domain, including zeros/constants
method.normalized_rmse: RMSE / sqrt(mean(reference^2)); null if reference RMS=0
method.temporal_mean_bias: candidate temporal mean minus reference temporal mean, per point
method.tsnr: temporal mean / population temporal SD (ddof=0); constant-series tSNR undefined and counted
method.absolute_p99: exact percentile across all point/frame absolute errors
method.memory: CPU NumPy validation with 8-frame reads and bounded exact-error buffers; no production GPU timing included

volume.domain: entire fixed TemplateFlow MNI152NLin6Asym res-02 brain mask, including zero and constant timeseries

reconstruction_geometry.reason: independent native reconstructions are not assumed to share topology or vertex correspondence; same-index mesh and sphere-angle errors require a separate validated geometry comparison

derived_arrays.publication: private derived arrays; only CC0 brain-masked figures and aggregate numbers approved for publication
